title: L5 대화-4
body_text:
B: Excuse me. I’m going to the National Art Museum. What’s the best way to get there?
G: You can walk. Go straight for about 500 meters and turn left. It’ll be on your right.
B: I see. How long will it take?
G: Only about 15 minutes.
B: Really? Thanks. What’s the best way to get to ~?
